touch_policy: No source protection; no invented stop/target/timeout. Both registered gap labels intentionally identical, onehistory. Shared no-pruning/failclosed caps retained.

principal_return_estimand: All admitted entry-to-exit-or-fixed-cutoff net reference returns; completed-only means separately descriptive. Per-unit return=(exit/entry)*(1-sidecost)/(1+sidecost)-1.
